europe_now.title: Poland Sets Border No-Fly Zone Amid Drone Incursions
europe_now.summary: Poland is establishing a dedicated no-fly zone along its border with Ukraine following recurring drone incursions originating from Russia. The measure aims to enhance regional security and protect airspace near the ongoing conflict.

sources.headline: Moscow drone incursions: Poland to create no-fly zone at Ukraine border

europe_now.title: Diesel Tanker Sinks Near Ibiza Causing Fatality
europe_now.summary: A diesel tanker carrying thousands of tonnes of fuel has capsized off the coast of Ibiza, resulting in the death of at least one crew member. Emergency responders and local authorities are managing the maritime incident and environmental risks.

sources.headline: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
Crew member dies after diesel tanker sinks off Ibiza coast

top_stories.title: European Central Bank Leadership Transition
top_stories.summary: EU leaders have cleared the path for Spanish economist Pablo Hernández de Cos to succeed Christine Lagarde as the head of the European Central Bank. The appointment marks a significant upcoming transition in leadership for the eurozone's monetary authority.

sources.headline: Spanish economist de Cos to succeed Lagarde as head of ECB
EU leaders clear path for Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos to lead ECB

top_stories.title: Polish Institutional Funding Friction
top_stories.summary: The Polish prime minister has ordered an alternative financing channel for the country's constitutional court after the central bank froze its accounts. This development highlights ongoing domestic institutional tensions and financial disputes within the state administration.

sources.headline: Polish PM orders alternative financing channel for constitutional court after central bank freezes accounts
